name: xrvxyr-launch-capacity
goal: Prove MB2 and primary launch sessions by available memory independently of CPU load and queue heavy test commands across worktrees at background priority

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Installed MB2 maxConcurrent=5, implicit non-Harbor cap=1, and non-Harbor launch holds at load 4; reproduce in scheduler with a hot, RAM-healthy Mac. Full checks use a single Mac lock and normal Playwright commands bypass it; prove an independent core-based heavy admission path.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Current host-resource and fleet telemetry integration cases encode CPU holds on launches. Strengthen them with an occupied-slot and RAM recovery lifecycle under unchanged high load, including auto placement and due grants. Exercise resource CLI test command classification and native lock contention separately.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 3e214c8b6e failed 5 assertions (21 passed): both launchers admitted zero of one at sustained load 23; overloaded peer was excluded from due and auto routing; Playwright wrapper had no --heavy-test. Harness red checkpoint recorded in a clean worktree.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Removed Mac CPU admission holds from explicit and automatic/due session paths. All launch paths share the memory reserve and general slot ceiling. Moved the macOS full-check lock into a shared two-lane policy for managed heavy test commands, with load recheck immediately before starting.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
